description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended lorlatinib, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for ALK-positive advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults who have not had an ALK inhibitor. Lorlatinib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
